sources.entry: Checkout this newsletter produced by Posthog: Product for Engineers

summary.title: build mode (Substack newsletter by PostHog)
summary.one_liner: A PostHog-produced Substack newsletter with posts on product building, AI product lessons, agent workflows, and product management for engineers.
takeaways: Posts cover tools, tactics and taste for product builders, written mainly by PostHog staff.
Recent topics include lessons from four years of building AI products and designing multi-human agent systems.
Several articles share practical agent guidance, such as writing agent skills and delegating work to agents.
Popular posts address product management from an engineer's perspective, such as vibe design and failure modes for team leads.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the build mode Substack publication, made by PostHog, which the page says has over 82,000 subscribers. It lists recent and popular posts rather than a single tutorial. Topics visible in the listing include AI product building, multiplayer agent systems, agent skills and autonomy, and product management for engineers. The page itself gives no detailed instructions, so the content is best understood from the individual post titles and blurbs.
